goal: P2: native-fidelity console on real backends — fidelity >= 90%, raise real coverage, no statics
must_build: Every page in ui-spec/gcp/firestore.json (12 pages; nav: All databases, {resource-name})
Backend: core gcp firestore (test_gcp_firestore_core.py, test_firestore_query_core.py): databases, collections/documents data viewer, query builder, indexes
List / create / detail / edit / delete round-trips through the native API the SDK and CLI use
always: Every page wired to the native API on /_wire (no static data); liveness fixtures for every list/detail page
core/capabilities/gcp/firestore.json: one entry per console section with an honest level + tests; tests/conformance/test_capabilities.py must pass

Read the 'Cloud lenses' section of consoles/AGENT-UI.md first — use this cloud's kit, not Cloudscape
